core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sawdah (سَوْدَة) is a historic Arabic feminine given name meaning 'noble sovereign', 'eminent in dignity', or 'fertile, lush landscape'. In Islamic history, it is the illustrious name of Mother of the Believers Sawdah bint Zam'ah al-Qurashiyyah, the first woman the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ married after the passing of Khadijah, celebrated for her profound generosity and early migration to Abyssinia.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Derived from siyādah (mastery, nobility, and preeminent honor), or referring to fertile, dark-green soil teeming with life.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The root s-w-d denotes nobility, leadership (sayyid), and lush fertility. Sawdah bint Zam'ah was an early convert in Mecca who bravely migrated to Abyssinia with her first husband. After his death, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ married her in Mecca, bringing comfort and maternal care to his household. She was renowned for her cheerful good nature, towering devotion, and extraordinary charity, frequently giving away large gifts of wealth the moment she received them.
